item.title: Bad Bunny Kicks Off Historic Residency in Madrid with Myke Towers as Surprise Guest
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this special edition of our podcast, where we dive into the hottest trends in music. Today, we're talking about Bad Bunny's electrifying 10-date Madrid residency.
[Cut to music clip: Bad Bunny's "Dákiti"]
Host: The Puerto Rican superstar kicked off his residency at a sold-out Riyadh Air Metropolitano on Saturday, May 30th, with a journey through his hit album "Debí Tirar Más Fotos" and other fan favorites. Over two-and-a-half hours, Bad Bunny took the crowd on a musical ride, alternating between celebratory moments, cultural references, and heartfelt expressions of gratitude.
[Cut to audio clip: Bad Bunny speaking at the concert]
Host: At the start of the show, Bad Bunny set the tone, saying, "It feels good to be here in Madrid. Tonight, we're going to sing a lot of songs we haven't sung before. I hope you're ready." And ready they were – the audience sang along to every chorus, making the night truly unforgettable.
[Cut to music clip: Bad Bunny's "La Mudanza"]
Host: The setlist included hits like "Callaíta," "Turista," "Tití Me Preguntó," and "Yonaguni," with the crowd maintaining their energy throughout the entire evening. Bad Bunny also took time to reflect on his career, thanking fans for their support over the years, especially those who believed in him from the very beginning.
[Cut to audio clip: Bad Bunny speaking at the concert]
Host: One of the most special moments came when Bad Bunny interacted with fans in the front rows during his segment in "La Casita," a replica of a Puerto Rican house. He even invited five lucky fans on stage after they repeated the iconic phrase "Acho, PR es otra cosa" – a ritual that's become a hallmark of his shows.
[Cut to music clip: Bad Bunny's "Adivino" with Myke Towers]
Host: Another highlight came when Myke Towers surprised the crowd by joining Bad Bunny on stage for their collaborative track "Adivino." The audience went wild, and Towers even treated them to a medley of his hits. Throughout the night, Puerto Rico was ever-present, from the music to the traditional hats and flags in the audience.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's special edition. Bad Bunny's Madrid residency is shaping up to be an unforgettable experience, and we can't wait to see what the rest of the tour has in store. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!
